name: convey
description: Write messages that tell people what they need, with the conclusion first and nothing the reader does not need, for Slack, Discord, email, or GitHub, checked for length, formatting, and private details before they are copied

interface.longDescription: Writes a message that tells people what they need, from the work in the conversation, pasted text, issues and pull requests, or commits. It decides who the message is for, picks one of seven types (progress, decision, request, incident, findings, announcement, or question), puts the conclusion on the first line, and leaves out preambles, restatements, and sign-offs. A script checks the message against the destination: Slack, Discord, an email, a GitHub comment, or plain text. It reports a message over the length limit with where to split it, formats the destination shows as typed, filler phrases, and secret-looking values, local paths, and email addresses without printing them, then copies the message to the clipboard. It never sends anything.
defaultPrompt: Share this work with my team on Slack
